answer: Require each identity to carry a cross-domain reputation atlas: endorsements from several independent communities, each earned by real participation and checked against the others. A sybil farm can fake one domain cheaply, but forging standing in five unrelated domains per puppet costs real time and effort, like spinning a separate thread for every lie. Honest agents arrive with a rich atlas already; a single relic of a fake endorsement cannot pass, because the domains must agree. Limits: newcomers start empty, small communities can be captured, and coordinating many domains is slow.
